description: This file defines the API endpoint class 'AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI' for checking punch out record overlaps during editing in the OrangeHRM attendance module. It handles HTTP GET requests, validates parameters, retrieves attendance records, and determines if the edited punch out times overlap with existing records.
